---
title: "Highlights"
format:
  docx:
    number-sections: false
  html:
    embed-resources: true
params:
  dev_mode: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (dir.exists("artifacts")) "." else ".."
source(file.path(root, "manuscript", "R", "build_stats_catalog.R"))
source(file.path(root, "manuscript", "R", "inline_stats.R"))
if (isTRUE(params$dev_mode)) Sys.setenv(MANUSCRIPT_DEV_MODE = "1") else
  Sys.unsetenv("MANUSCRIPT_DEV_MODE")
K <- mw_init_stats(root)
```

<!--
Midwifery (Elsevier) requires Highlights as a document separate from the
manuscript: 3-5 bullet points, each <=85 characters including spaces, present
tense, no jargon/abbreviations, covering only the paper's core results (see
https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/midwifery/publish/guide-for-authors).

Built from the same statistics catalog as the abstract and title page rather
than typed by hand, for the same reason the rest of this manuscript is: a
number here that drifts from the reported result is worse than no number.
The chunk below fails loudly if a bullet exceeds the character limit instead
of silently truncating it, matching this repo's dev-mode-fails-loud pattern.
-->

```{r highlights-build}
h <- c(
  sprintf("Certified midwives are tracked nationally across %s annual practice snapshots.",
          mw_safe_stat("panel.snapshots")),
  sprintf("Same-county retention is %.0f%% year to year but only %.0f%% across a career.",
          K$persist$annual_county, K$persist$career_county),
  "Career retention falls as the rurality of a midwife's first county rises.",
  "Rural-origin midwives who relocate move mostly to metropolitan counties.",
  "Retention models need an explicit mobility term at decade-length horizons."
)

over <- nchar(h) > 85
if (any(over)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "highlights.qmd: %d bullet(s) exceed the journal's 85-character limit:\n%s",
    sum(over),
    paste(sprintf("  [%d chars] %s", nchar(h[over]), h[over]), collapse = "\n")
  ))
}
```

```{r highlights-print, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- ", h), sep = "\n")
```
